ledger.x: 1739: Raghoji I Bhonsle founds the Nagpur kingdom.
19 April 1742: the Marathas take Barabati fort at Cuttack.
May or June 1751: the Bengal treaty ends the wars.
Between 1745 and 1755: Chanda is added to the dominions of Raghoji I (same sentence); dated at the end of the span.
Between 1745 and 1755: Sambalpur is added to the dominions of Raghoji I (same sentence); dated at the end of the span.
1785: Mandla and the upper Narmada valley are added by treaty with the Peshwa.
17 December 1803: Raghoji II signs the Treaty of Deogaon and gives up Cuttack.

wars.name: Maratha expedition in the Carnatic
wars.outcome: Raghuji's army defeated Dost Ali Khan at Damalcherry on 20 May 1740; no Nagpur territory resulted.

wars.name: Maratha invasions of Bengal
wars.outcome: The Nawab ceded Orissa and paid chauth of 12 lakh rupees a year from October 1751 under a treaty of May or June 1751; the Subarnarekha was fixed as the boundary.

wars.name: Second Anglo-Maratha War
wars.outcome: Wellesley beat the Bhonsle at Argaon on 29 November 1803; Raghoji II signed the Treaty of Deogaon on 17 December 1803 and gave up Cuttack.

wars.name: Third Anglo-Maratha War
wars.outcome: Appa Sahib was defeated at Sitabuldi and Nagpur (26 November 1817) and a treaty of 9 January 1818 left the British in control of most of his territory.

certainty.note: Chauth and conquered provinces: the pages give provinces, towns and rivers; only the Subarnarekha boundary of 1751 is a named line.
Treaty cessions of 1803 and 1818 name provinces; the drawn provinces are circles around the district towns, so the edge is approximate.
